title: Swabe Sitao (Swabe pole sitao): Characteristics
metaDescription: Swabe sitao is a not stated sitao variety from Harbest Agribusiness. See its days to harvest, yield, pest ratings, traits and where it grows best.
excerpt: Swabe sitao is a not stated sitao variety, also sold or known as Swabe pole sitao. It is not a registered variety, so the facts here come from its seller and farm sources. It comes from Harbest Agribusiness.

heroImage.alt: A farmer watering vegetable beds in Pulilan, Bulacan, the kind of farm where Swabe sitao is grown

blocks.text: If you came here looking for Swabe pole sitao, this is the same sitao. The facts below come from its seller and from farm sources, each one listed at the end. Compare it with the others in our [sitao variety finder](/crop-varieties/sitao), or see [every crop variety](/crop-varieties) we list. For the crop itself, read our guide: [Land preparation for legumes](/land-preparation/legume-land-preparation).

blocks.text: How long does it take, and how much does it yield?

Days to harvest, by the seller's count: 50 to 55 days after sowing. No trial on record checks this figure yet, so treat it as the seller's own and compare with farms near you before you plan a season around it.

Once you know the day count, anee.io dates every task from each lot's own planting day, with [the growth stages and weather](/features/growth-stages-and-weather) beside it.
Is it resistant to pests and diseases?
No pest or disease ratings are published for this variety. So treat it as untested, and scout every week.

The pests and diseases that hit sitao fields most often: [anthracnose](/diseases/anthracnose), [bean fly](/pests/bean-fly), [cutworm](/pests/cutworm), [leafminer](/pests/leafminer), [legume pod borer](/pests/legume-pod-borer). Our [pest finder](/pests) and [disease finder](/diseases) help you name what you see.
What its seller and farm sources say

items: **Days to harvest:** 50 to 55 days after sowing.
High yielding and prolific, vigorous vines.

blocks.text: Why farmers know it: the pole sitao on the Best Sellers page of Harbest's current seed catalogue. These are the seller's own figures, from its own trials. So plant a small area first, and compare it with your usual sitao on the same ground.
Where and when to plant Swabe sitao

Pole sitao climbs a trellis and bears for weeks, while bush sitao needs no trellis and comes in at once. Pick long, dark green pods that snap cleanly, and a variety rated against the bean fly and rust if you can. Before planting, get the field ready with our guide: [Pagtatanim ng gulay](/crops/pagtatanim-ng-gulay).

items.q: Is Swabe pole sitao the same as Swabe?
items.a: Yes. Swabe pole sitao is another name for Swabe. Seed sellers use both, so ask for either one.

items.q: Where can I buy seed of Swabe?
items.a: Ask an accredited seed dealer in your province, the seller named on this page or your municipal agriculturist. Look for the certified seed tag or a sealed pack before you pay.
